column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule thresholds (issue #785)
# Anything not listed here uses ZAP's default threshold (WARN). Entries here
# either silence a known false positive or explicitly escalate a category we
# want to always fail the build on. See docs/SECURITY_SCANNING_RUNBOOK.md for
# the triage process before adding new IGNORE rules.
# Retest cookie flags on /health and /metrics only after confirming they
# carry no session state — these are unauthenticated, stateless endpoints.
# Server header / X-Powered-By disclosure is already stripped by helmet in
# production; the informational finding on the dev/CI server is expected.
# Always fail the build on reflected/stored XSS and SQL injection findings,
